name: com.nobnak.water-simulation
description: A comparative water simulation package featuring 2D Wave Equation, Boussinesq model, and FFT ocean surfaces.

samples.description: 2D Wave equation simulation demonstrating immediate ripple response, obstacle reflection, and slit diffraction.
Boussinesq water wave simulation with bathymetry response, wave shoaling, refraction, and energy convergence.
Cascaded FFT ocean surface with spectrum parameters for calm, swell, and stormy sea states.
Side-by-side comparison between linear wave equation and Boussinesq system focusing on frequency dispersion.
Overview and interactive switcher for all three water simulation models.
